title: rays.trace spec
description: What a rays.trace request asks for: n given rays, traced at one line of the case. Lengths in mm, in the contract frame. Code checks that the three arrays describe the same n rays, that every direction is a unit vector toward +z and that every weight is finite and not negative.

line.description: The index of the line of the case, in conditions.lines, whose indices the rays are traced with.

origins.description: Where each ray starts, in front of the first surface; shape [n, 3].

directions.description: The unit direction of each ray, its z component above 0; shape [n, 3].

weights.description: The flux each ray stands for, finite and not negative; shape [n].

groups.description: What the rays are, for whoever reads the answer: the field they come from, the lattice they lie on and which of them is the chief ray. An engine traces the rays and reads none of it.

angleDeg.description: The field angle in degrees; a positive angle is an object toward +y.

heightFraction.description: The fraction of the full image height the angle was resolved from.

lattice.description: The first columns x rows rays are the cells of a square lattice, row by row: ray row x columns + column.

step.description: The side of a cell on the plane the lattice is laid on.

chiefIndex.description: The index of the ray that is the chief ray of the field.
